t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Pairs of gnomes seem to give best. Right side tended to get mushrooms if any. Red basket also tended to do well.

vb_textbox.text: Pairs of Gnomes hold better value. Some colours hold better value then others - green and purple seem to have the highest value. The rules seem to change per round. Once you have learnt the rules of the first round it appears to change in the following rounds. First and second round mushroom like gnomes seemed to hold the best value. The red basket seemed to be in my favour these rounds. In the third and fourth rounds pointy gnomes seemed to hold the best value. The yellow basket seemed in be in my favour in these rounds.
